title: Claude credits not worth...?
author: Typical_Sky8316
selftext:
Man, i thought buying Claude credits were worth.

I left my Claude with the task of giving values(dmg, atk speed, distance, selling value) to around 70 weapons. The 3D models are already done and working in-game with default values.

Thing is, just when i gave the task to Claude i ran out of my weekly credits. So i pumped 5$ in credits thinking it would be like at least 10% of the monthly use of credits (20$ subscription).  
  
It wasn't. Not only that, they literally lasted a bit over a minute and ran out of credits again. It didn't even complete half the weapon values.  
  
i know 5$ is not a lot, and i know i should have read about how much is 5$ worth in usage but i was expecting a bit more. At the end, it was a fairly simple task; replace existing values.

PS: I was using opus 5.5 in high.

comments.author: Shadowlance23
comments.body:
Dude, this is not something you should be farming off to AI. This is game balance work, which really needs a human touch.

My trick is to get the AI to build editors, then you just fill out a nice form with the values you need. Easy to tweak, easy to add new values and no need to pay.

You could even have it set up to export/import to a spreadsheet, then just update all the values at once and import again.

comments.author: Snoo-29395
comments.body:
Im more concerned about the fact you have 70 weapons. I totally understand the hype about the amount of work you can get done with AI, but I encourage you to take a step back and think about you want to accomplish. Even with AI, there’s no way a solo dev can go away with that number. Impossible to balance and probably they will all feel the same. 

That being said, best of luck with the game. And just in case, this is not a hate comment or anything, is just and advice!
